mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC of the signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over a 3-month period indicates growing demand in the economy, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where HOUST shows a sustained increase, or if the Rank IC of the signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a single month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC of the signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a single month signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC of the signal remains below 0.05 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 1% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% in the same period, it signals a strong consumer-driven economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 1% and UNRATE decrease > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC of the signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a single month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2%, signals a robust labor market and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 300,000 and UNRATE decrease > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC of the signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) over a 3-month period, indicating inflationary pressures, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate monetary tightening.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL shows a sustained increase, or if the Rank IC of the signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a single month signals a contraction in economic activity, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC of the signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.
